skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master English terminology used in the insurance industry, including health insurance and commercial insurance.
Analyze legal documents related to insurance, including contracts and regulations.
Manage insurance contracts and proposals effectively.
Understand and manage operations in an insurance firm, including commercial and social insurance.
Understand and apply principles of risk management in insurance.
Understand and comply with legal requirements in the insurance industry.
Demonstrate independent and collaborative work skills, critical thinking, and adaptability in a global context.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics and legal obligations in the insurance industry.
Communicate effectively in English in professional insurance contexts.
Understand and explain various types of insurance products.
Understand and apply insurance laws and regulations.
Understand social insurance systems and their regulations.
